result.topic_en: The page describes labelling the pieces of a real algebraic curve, which is cut up by its double points, to build a schema that can stand in for the Riemann surface. It then begins a note that the consistency of Euclidean and hence non-Euclidean geometry can be shown analytically.
result.transcription:

die $i+1$te Wurzel dem absoluten Betrage nach
übereinstimmen.
Das so entstehende
Schema ist von neben-
stehender Art und
